descricao: The rooms in the halls are mostly empty. Usually, the rooms will have wooden chairs lying around, or wooden tables all in horrible condition. Few rooms have a window, although some may be Entity 2, some are safe, and show a deep blue ocean with the room itself, usually glowing a deep blue from this effect. Rarely, a room can be filled with water, but the water seems to stay still when the door is opened. When inside a room, wanderers tend to feel lonely even if there are others around them. Rarely, wanderers will be able to hear old boat noises, and slight whispers.
entidades: Entity 2, Smilers, Hounds, Skin-Stealers, Camo Crawler
